# Vendored Studio Assets

The standalone putting studio loads nothing from a CDN at runtime (design of
record on epic #14141). These files are vendored unmodified or generated as
recorded here; do not edit them by hand.

| File               | Source                                                                                           | License                  | SHA-256                                                            |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `three.min.js`     | npm `three@0.128.0`, `build/three.min.js` (r128, the release the Gemini studio pinned)           | MIT (`three.LICENSE`)    | `9274bbcec8d96168626c732b5d31c775aa8cfb7eaa0599bec0c175908a2c1ce2` |
| `tailwind.min.css` | Generated by `tailwindcss@3.4.17` from the studio markup (replaces the Tailwind Play CDN script) | MIT (`tailwind.LICENSE`) | `344f3dd14a8660cd95557b541843501b409e9fdaa4caf13bee4e9521f7bb8ad3` |

Fonts: the studio falls back to the system font stack instead of loading
Google Fonts.

## Regenerating `tailwind.min.css`

Run from `src/apps/putting_studio/` after changing classes in the markup or
scripts, then update the hash above:

```bash
printf '@tailwind base;\n@tailwind components;\n@tailwind utilities;\n' > /tmp/tw-in.css
npx --yes tailwindcss@3.4.17 -i /tmp/tw-in.css -o "$PWD/vendor/tailwind.min.css" \
  --content "$PWD/index.html,$PWD/js/*.js" --minify
```
